data.cultural_impact: The name 'Rupan' is a common one in the Hindu culture. It signifies wealth, prosperity, and success. It is often given to children who are believed to embody these qualities and bring them into their families and communities. The name is also a reminder of the importance of valuing one's inner beauty and wisdom above material possessions.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name 'Rupan' carries a deeper spiritual meaning as well. It is believed to represent the spiritual wealth and inner beauty that one possesses. The name is seen as a reminder to always value and cultivate one's inner self, as it is the true source of wealth and happiness. This name can inspire individuals to seek spiritual growth and enlightenment, knowing that their true value lies within themselves.
